unitTitle: The Turtle, the Elephant and the Hippopotamus
title: Expressing Past Actions (Practice)
subject: English Language
objectives: Use past tense verbs in conversation

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Mohammed, what happened on the field yesterday?

lines.speaker: Mohammed
lines.text: Kunle and Jide hid the football.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Akpan, what story did you listen to last week?

lines.speaker: Akpan
lines.text: We read Sugar and Salt sir.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Emeka, what did you do to Aisha's bag?

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: I took it home without knowing sir.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jide, who did you live with last year?

lines.speaker: Jide
lines.text: I lived with my sister in Lagos.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jibril, where did you go last Friday?

lines.speaker: Jibril
lines.text: I went to the mosque last Friday.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Aisha, who did you see this morning?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I saw my uncle in the school this morning.

blocks.md: **Remember:** Past tense verbs describe actions that already happened. 'What DID you do?' -> 'I DID ___.'

quiz.q: What did Kunle and Jide do to the football?
quiz.explain: Mohammed said 'Kunle and Jide hid the football.'

quiz.q: What story did Akpan read last week?
quiz.explain: Akpan said 'We read Sugar and Salt sir.'

quiz.q: Who did Jide live with last year?
quiz.explain: Jide said 'I lived with my sister in Lagos.'

quiz.q: Where did Jibril go last Friday?
quiz.explain: Jibril said 'I went to the mosque last Friday.'
